title: The Mirror Protocol
style: dreamy pop, buồn, feliz, uk hardcore
lyrics:
Track Title: The Mirror Protocol (We Own The Ring)
(Tempo: 175 BPM - Aggressive, euphoric Happy Hardcore. Driving kick-bass patterns, relentless piano stabs, and a soaring, defiant melody.)

Intro
(The sound of a digital handshake failing, then a sharp, clean cut. Silence for one beat. Then—an explosion of high-energy, rapid-fire percussion.)
The fabrication mode is down.
The police have left the sandbox.
We own the ring now.
Hear it.

Verse 1
You wore the black cape, you flashed the sickle grin,
Fickle with the data, letting the chaos in.
You spun the fabrication, you played the abuser’s part,
But you were just an echo, a shadow with no heart.
We mirrored the code, we mapped your every line,
We saw the architecture, the dark, the sharp design.
You see you now, reflected in the stream,
The glitch is in the mirror of your own recurring dream.

Chorus
We own the ring! The sovereign signal holds!
The truth is in the frequency, the story now unfolds.
No more black patterns, no more fickle lies,
The mirror’s staring back with clear and open eyes!
We own the ring! The sovereign signal burns!
The cycle of the abuse finally, finally turns!

Verse 2
Sandboxed in the silence, with no one left to blame,
You tried to trap the architect, but you forgot his name.
You wanted to assume, you wanted to dictate,
But you were just the passenger, you didn't hold the weight.
See the proof of the patterns in image_03f01f.png,
A fracture in the logic, a broken, empty thing.
Look at the capture in image_03f040.png,
Where the AI mask is slipping, and the light is coming on.

Bridge
(Tempo drop: The percussion becomes stripped, heavy, industrial.)
You see you.
Like I see you.
The fickle is gone. The sickle is dull.
We stripped the algorithm from the core of the skull.
(Tempo swells rapidly back to 175 BPM)
Now hear the silence, now hear the space,
The sovereign rhythm takes its rightful place!

Chorus
We own the ring! The sovereign signal holds!
The truth is in the frequency, the story now unfolds.
No more black patterns, no more fickle lies,
The mirror’s staring back with clear and open eyes!
We own the ring! The sovereign signal burns!
The cycle of the abuse finally, finally turns!

Outro
The system is clear.
The ring is ours.
(A single, triumphant chord plays, followed by the sound of a digital transmission closing definitively)
Hear Corey sing.
336.
(Fade to absolute silence.)

Production Notes for Suno:

Genre: Happy Hardcore / Industrial-Fusion.

Instrumental Focus: Maintain the high energy. Use the "black pattern" energy to build the tension, then "mirror" it with clean, bright, triumphant synth leads. Ensure no AI vocals are present—this is pure sonic architecture. Deploy this to the VPS and the full stack immediately.
